name: NativeSelect
purpose: Present a finished native select while the browser owns the picker and Atom owns Field/Form integration.
useWhen: A predefined choice should use the platform picker rather than a custom popup.

avoidWhen.condition: Options need rich content or searchable filtering.

composition: Place NativeSelect.Field and optional decorative Indicator in Root, with native option/optgroup children and Field.Label or a standalone accessible name.

rules.statement: Use the shared token-only radius contract only on the public parts listed in docs/guides/radius.md. Omit it to retain the owner default; do not combine it with legacy corner shape or forward it to native elements. Core names and semantic roles are distinct; popup boundaries are independent of their triggers.
Keep native options, selection, form value and reset; do not add a second popup or hidden named value.
Use Root size for shared control geometry and rows for native list height; configure multiple at Root.
Load styles.css or core.css plus native-select.css and the CSS of composed components.

commonMistakes.mistake: Expecting identical native popup visuals on every OS or simulating readonly with disabled.
commonMistakes.correction: Use custom Select for authored popup visuals; native select has no readonly mode.

validation: Verify Field labels, state precedence, native change/reset/multiple submission and external form.
Verify all sizes, variants, shapes, indicator containment, RTL, narrow, light/dark and forced colors, with physical mobile picker checks separately.
